info.name: Clinic Management System
info.description:
Complete API collection for Clinic Management System.

## Setup
1. Import this collection.
2. Import the **Clinic Management - Env** environment file.
3. Run **Patient → Register** → token auto-saved.
4. Run **Clinic → Register** → token auto-saved.
5. Run **Admin → Login** → token auto-saved.

All subsequent requests use the saved tokens automatically.

item.name: 🔐 Auth Service
item.description: Registration and login for all three roles. Tokens are auto-saved to collection variables.
